f31516.title: DAAK_TECH architecture and route inventory (source orientation)
f31516.content:
## Product and boundaries
Next.js App Router public French marketing/portfolio site, installed Next 16.4.3 / React 19.2.8. 73 source files, 104 source/static asset files. No app authentication, sessions, tenants, database, XML processing, command runner or arbitrary server-side URL fetch found in current `src`. Root AGENTS.md warns consult `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before edits. No nested instructions in src/public/assets or SECURITY.md identified. `src/app(public)` is a legacy-looking sibling outside real `src/app`; `.agents/.claude/.cursor/.devin`, venv and strix_runs are tooling, not runtime. Package argon2 and notion are not imported in src.

## Routes
GET `/`, `/a-propos`, `/services`, `/services/[slug]` (10 static records), `/realisations`, `/realisations/[slug]` (6 records), `/contact?service=<static-slug>`, `/mentions-legales`, `/politique-confidentialite`; metadata `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`; GET `/api/health`; POST `/api/contact`. Redirects `/about-us` -> `/a-propos`, `/contact-us` -> `/contact` in next.config.ts. robots excludes /admin despite no matching route. Dynamic slug handlers call static get*BySlug then notFound; path does not directly enter filesystem or network fetch.

## Contact flow
`src/components/forms/contact-form.tsx:204-311`: client Zod -> multipart FormData -> `/api/contact`. `src/app/api/contact/route.ts:98`: content-type gate -> `request.formData()` at 137 -> `website` honeypot -> explicit name/company/email/phone/service/budget/deadline/message extraction -> `contactServerSchema.safeParse` at 228 (bounded strings, valid email, static slug allowlist) -> optional attachment <=4MiB at 284, extension allowlist at 307, nonempty declared MIME allowlist at 338, filename sanitized at 87, base64 at 363 -> `sendContactEmails` at 391. No document parser or disk save on this route. `src/lib/email/contact-email.ts:43-50` reads operator RESEND_API_KEY/EMAIL_FROM/CONTACT_EMAIL; first Resend send 79 uses fixed operator recipient + user replyTo, second 246 sends static confirmation to submitted email. All user HTML interpolation uses escapeHtml 23-29. Errors are generic to client; SDK details logged server-side. Privacy page 37-40 confirms email-only attachments.

## Prioritized risk surfaces (unvalidated, not findings)
Anonymous mail authority/confirmation abuse and retry/idempotency behavior; total multipart body parsing before per-file bound; attachment declared MIME/extension handling at mail boundary; email/header/template escaping. No app rate limit, origin check or CAPTCHA observed, but reverse proxy may impose controls and missing controls alone are not findings. Old `savePrivateAttachment` helper has no callers; reference generator also unused. `resolveProjectImage` checks paths from developer project data, not request slug directly. Video and Google Maps integrations are browser-side with developer-controlled data. Do not test linked portfolio external sites; only repo/local services authorized here.

## Git and tooling
Latest commits: 1d6e4b4 favicon, f028913 static redirects, 1e97bec WhatsApp/budget/contact diagnostics. Broad working-tree modifications preexist (many may be CRLF differences); do not overwrite. Use `git -c safe.directory=/workspace/DAAK_TECH` per command; pager disabled recommended. Shell workaround is `shell=/bin/sh,login=false,tty=true`; non-TTY exec and /bin/bash login=false returned blank/126. Semgrep ownership is this mapper, artifacts `/workspace/.source-architecture`; scanner running; AST target file will derive from semgrep scope. Secrets/dependency/runtime scans delegated elsewhere.

d6040b.title: Source mapper scan results and deterministic AST artifacts
d6040b.content:
Completed bounded semgrep scan over `src`, `next.config.ts`, `package.json` using `p/default`, `p/typescript`, `p/secrets`; 216 active rules / 74 files / 99.9% parsed. Raw `semgrep.json`, summary and log under `/workspace/.source-architecture/`. Five scanner hits reduce to two audit candidates: four chained replaceAll warnings in `src/lib/email/contact-email.ts:24` and one path.join warning in `src/lib/files/al-private-storage.ts:51`. Both source-level candidates closed with named controls in coverage: all email user strings use complete HTML escaping in HTML text-node contexts; private-storage destination uses random UUID plus path.extname-derived suffix, never original filename. No vulnerabilities confirmed or reports filed.

Required AST pass completed successfully after deriving `sg-targets.txt` from `semgrep.json` `paths.scanned`, retaining 72 JS/TS source targets. `ast-handlers.json` contains four exported async route/page functions; `ast-imports.json` contains 206 structural import mappings. Both `sg run` executions exit 0; output is bounded (<250KiB combined). Script `/workspace/.source-architecture/map_ast.py` preserves deterministic regeneration. A partial Semgrep parse warning concerns `src/components/public/home-hero.tsx:21` JSX text `& informatiques`; other files scanned. Dynamic validation was intentionally not performed by mapper: runtime/testing belongs to other agents. Secret/dependency scans belong to other agents. No product files modified.

206290.title: Local runtime ready at 127.0.0.1:3100; outbound email disabled
206290.content:
## Startup
Working directory `/workspace/DAAK_TECH`.
Command: `env RESEND_API_KEY= EMAIL_FROM= CONTACT_EMAIL= NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100`.
Running PID `2199`, terminal session `11104`; bound only to `127.0.0.1:3100`. Stop with Ctrl-C to that session or `kill 2199`.
Node `24.18.0`, npm `11.16.0`, Next `16.4.3`, React `19.2.8` per manifest.

## Isolation
Existing `.env` contains an actual Resend key: never use it. Explicit exported **empty** `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM`, and `CONTACT_EMAIL` take precedence over `.env`. `src/lib/email/contact-email.ts` checks `!apiKey` and throws `RESEND_API_KEY_MISSING` before `new Resend` or either outbound send. Do not replace empty key with a dummy nonempty key, because that could still send external provider requests. No DB, auth, payment service found in runtime source, so no synthetic accounts needed. No form submission was sent by runtime preparation. There is no OS-level network sandbox; isolation is the verified application env guard. Static pages can contain outbound links/assets, so other testers must stay local.

## Smoke observations
GET `/api/health`: 200 JSON `{"status":"ok","service":"DAAK_TECH"}` with `cache-control: no-store, max-age=0`.
GET `/`, `/contact`, `/services`, `/realisations`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`: 200.
GET `/about-us`: 308 to local `/a-propos`.

## Limitations and preparation notes
Serving existing `.next` production build created Nov 4 on Windows, rather than rebuilding current source. `.next/required-server-files.json` records Windows original appDir; live smoke nonetheless works. Source/build parity is not yet proven, so current-source-only checks should explicitly acknowledge this gap. Next warns `next start` with `output: standalone`; standalone output location was not yet verified but existing standard server serves normally.
Bundled node_modules initially had only Windows SWC/sharp native packages. Next auto-downloaded Linux GNU SWC into its normal `node_modules/next/next-swc-fallback`; startup initially hung while also downloading musl. Restart after GNU extraction succeeded without further download. No existing source/config files modified. Preinstalled Linux image optimization (`sharp`) may remain unavailable, untested. Initial pipe-based exec returned blank; all useful commands require `shell=/bin/bash, login=false, tty=true`.

89c79a.title: Secrets/SCA scan artifact inventory and advisory access limits
89c79a.content: Artifacts outside product tree in `/workspace/.secrets-sca/`: gitleaks-working-tree.json/log (604 KB scan; only .env:1 operator Resend key, fully redacted), gitleaks-history.json/log (all 9 commits, 759 KB, zero findings), package-inventory.json (458 lock entries), imports.txt, trivy-version*.json and scan logs. .env is ignored and not git-tracked; runtime-independent exposure validation assigned df57685d, not assumed vulnerable. Exact installed=pinned Next 16.4.3, React/DOM 19.2.8, Resend 6.32.1, zod 4.6.7. Trivy 0.73.0 has no vuln DB; update from mirror.gcr.io timed out, cached fallback fails first-run DB requirement. npm audit --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts timed out at 100s; OSV/registry proxy requests failed; web_search not configured. Dependency coverage a4ae57 remains needs_follow_up. All registry packages have integrity and default npm provenance. Use shell=bash,login=false,tty=true for visible exec outputs. Git must use command-scoped `-c safe.directory=/workspace/DAAK_TECH`; gitleaks git uses GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 path.

9526e3.title: Runtime email isolation verified in compiled code; SDK supports local provider base URL
9526e3.content: PID2199 `/proc/2199/environ` confirms RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, CONTACT_EMAIL all present with length0. Compiled artifact `.next/server/chunks/_1cziy273g2oqv._.js` explicitly reads process.env values and throws `RESEND_API_KEY_MISSING` before `new Resend`, matching source guard. SDK compiled code also supports `process.env.RESEND_BASE_URL || "https://api.resend.com"`; if a validator needs successful send behavior without external effects, a **separate** local-only mail stub and restarted app with synthetic credentials and `RESEND_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<stub-port>` can be used. Current runtime intentionally remains empty-key and cannot complete send operations. Existing `.next/standalone/server.js` is present though next start currently responds correctly.
